subject: reasoning
question:
Select from the alternatives, the box that can be formed by folding the sheet as shown in figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6147784c04be1b8872d67dbdcb59db91f5b2e889e20c0e541c38c007568bca81.png]
solution:
The folding the paper cutting along the lines to make a cubical box is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7637623fd439b8d7c5dcb4b5b802fe732d5433d7b140f2e7c45976e46bc6e33.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb1858c87383ae596569a4d2cc9f5999c13f614d248f94fb52a85c4d6b63e451.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6cf96f92ffa3009248df7877be8094af2398a036ae0f20285b92c8b09e6bcd3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc554deb41fcfe9a5ee7a1713a843a971836552c7f1ea1d54929069038ccab2.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d02968049483ffdd688cf9dfa2e73f1ca25b92cf3ec161762ece99256b1ce1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb1858c87383ae596569a4d2cc9f5999c13f614d248f94fb52a85c4d6b63e451.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a54f4fd95e2dccfb4835db7363ef77c0a899b5d01215cf164b7716e5e49dec8.png] 

So, each checking option one by one:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50c926a9ad990cbdc4f73dd3c9454077457ce7b6fb0b70678075842d1cca828.png] ⇒ Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb1858c87383ae596569a4d2cc9f5999c13f614d248f94fb52a85c4d6b63e451.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6cf96f92ffa3009248df7877be8094af2398a036ae0f20285b92c8b09e6bcd3.png] .

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf07e7d69c655a0207b1fdd16e0783e51779b92468f33e64487003a7fc3b739d.png] ⇒ Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc554deb41fcfe9a5ee7a1713a843a971836552c7f1ea1d54929069038ccab2.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d02968049483ffdd688cf9dfa2e73f1ca25b92cf3ec161762ece99256b1ce1.png] .

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5f018a99cc6e6e1bce6a79abc07bff4ba586f900acd41da629d41d14b34d2a2.png] ⇒ Can be made because all are the opposite sides..

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a27d84b03ad4d4f3e548431e944682bd1551b834f22272a9dc3f912fb73b78c8.png] ⇒ Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc554deb41fcfe9a5ee7a1713a843a971836552c7f1ea1d54929069038ccab2.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d02968049483ffdd688cf9dfa2e73f1ca25b92cf3ec161762ece99256b1ce1.png] .

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
